text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I couldn't do it! You're so much
stronger
than you were before, Ikuno...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
But... yeah, I'll get you next time! I'll
train a whole
bunch so I can do better
next time!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Tannhauser...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate the sentiment. Running with
you
today has been a pleasure.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: What's wrong? You sound so stiff.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...I was in peak condition for today's
race.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I am satisfied with the results.
However, I
can't let
myself become complacent.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
If I do, I'm sure you'll catch up to me in
no time.
You made that very clear in
today's race.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to running with you
again.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. You think so? You're making me
blush! I
can't wait to run with you again
too.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
By the way, there's somewhere I'd like to
go on
the way back. Would you care to
join me?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Where's that?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: A bathhouse.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
From the heat of the bath to the
pressure of the
water, it is a multifaceted
approach to relaxing
your body.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Essentially, when you're tired, you need
to
recover. That cycle helps maintain
better health
going forward.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I-I see!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Now that we've decided, let's hurry up
and go. Taking a bath for too long can
have the opposite
effect, so make sure
not to stay in too long.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... It's so waaarm.
I can feel it right
down
into my bones.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I bet I'm gonna sleep real well tonight...

Mm-hmm...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. That is the most important thing...
But
don't sleep in the bath, okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two of them warm both their bodies
and souls
in the bath, reinvigorating
themselves for their
upcoming races.
